<content>
1: // Minimal Cosmic Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: (function(){
4:   const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width=canvas.width=canvas.clientWidth||800;
7:   const height=canvas.height=canvas.clientHeight||600;
8: 
9:   // ship state
10:   const ship={x:width/2,y:height/2,angle:0,dx:0,dy:0,radius:10};
11:   const thrust=0.1, friction=0.99, turnSpeed=0.07;
12: 
13:   // asteroids
14:   const asteroids=[];
15:   const asteroidSize=30;
16:   function spawnAsteroid(){
17:     const edge=Math.random()*4|0; // 0 top,1 right,2 bottom,3 left
18:     let x,y,vx,vy;
19:     if(edge===0){x=Math.random()*width; y=-asteroidSize; vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*2; vy=Math.random()*2+1;}
20:     else if(edge===1){x=width+asteroidSize; y=Math.random()*height; vx=- (Math.random()*2+1); vy=(Math.random()-0.5)*2;}
21:     else if(edge===2){x=Math.random()*width; y=height+asteroidSize; vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*2; vy=-(Math.random()*2+1);}
22:     else {x=-asteroidSize; y=Math.random()*height; vx=Math.random()*2+1; vy=(Math.random()-0.5)*2;}
23:     // play a short ping when asteroid appears
24:     if (typeof playBeep === 'function') playBeep(300,0.05);
25:     asteroids.push({x,y,vx,vy,radius:asteroidSize*Math.random()*0.5+0.5});
26:   }
27: 
28:   // input handling
29:   const keys={};
30:   // Audio setup
31:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
32:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
33:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
34:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
35:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
36:     osc.connect(gain);
37:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
38:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
39:     osc.start();
40:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
41:   }
42:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
43:     keys[e.code]=true;
44:     // resume audio context on first interaction
45:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
46:     // thrust sound
47:     if (e.code==='ArrowUp' || e.code==='KeyW') {
48:       playBeep(440, 0.08);
49:     }
50:   });
51:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.code]=false);
52: 
53:   function update(){
54:     // ship rotation
55:     if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['KeyA']) ship.angle-=turnSpeed;
56:     if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['KeyD']) ship.angle+=turnSpeed;
57:     // thrust forward
58:     if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['KeyW']){ship.dx+=Math.cos(ship.angle)*thrust; ship.dy+=Math.sin(ship.angle)*thrust;}
59:     // apply friction
60:     ship.dx*=friction; ship.dy*=friction;
61:     ship.x+=ship.dx; ship.y+=ship.dy;
62:     // wrap ship
63:     if(ship.x<0) ship.x+=width; if(ship.x>width) ship.x-=width;
64:     if(ship.y<0) ship.y+=height; if(ship.y>height) ship.y-=height;
65:     // asteroids movement
66:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{a.x+=a.vx; a.y+=a.vy; if(a.x< -asteroidSize) a.x=width+asteroidSize; if(a.x>width+asteroidSize) a.x=-asteroidSize; if(a.y< -asteroidSize) a.y=height+asteroidSize; if(a.y>height+asteroidSize) a.y=-asteroidSize;});
67:     // collision detection
68:     for(const a of asteroids){
69:       const dx=ship.x-a.x, dy=ship.y-a.y;
70:       if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<ship.radius+a.radius){
71:         // Game over – stop animation
72:         playBeep(200,0.3);
73:         cancelAnimationFrame(anim);
74:         ctx.fillStyle='red';
75:         ctx.font='48px sans-serif';
76:         ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2-120, height/2);
77:         return;
78:       }
79:     }
80:   }
81: 
82:   function draw(){
83:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);
84:     // draw background stars
85:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
86:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
87:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
88:     for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
89:       const sx = Math.random() * width;
90:       const sy = Math.random() * height;
91:       ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1, 1);
92:     }
93:     // draw ship with thrust flame
94:     ctx.save();
95:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
96:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
97:     // ship body
98:     ctx.beginPath();
99:     ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
100:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 8);
101:     ctx.lineTo(-5, 0);
102:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -8);
103:     ctx.closePath();
104:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
105:     ctx.fill();
106:     // thrust flame when accelerating
107:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW']) {
108:       ctx.beginPath();
109:       ctx.moveTo(-8, 5);
110:       ctx.lineTo(-14, 0);
111:       ctx.lineTo(-8, -5);
112:       ctx.closePath();
113:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
114:       ctx.fill();
115:     }
116:     ctx.restore();
117:     // draw asteroids
118:     ctx.fillStyle='gray';
119:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(a.x,a.y,a.radius,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();});
120:   }
121: 
122:   function loop(){
123:     update();
124:     draw();
125:     anim=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
126:   }
127: 
128:   // start spawning asteroids
129:   setInterval(spawnAsteroid,1000);
130:   let anim=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
131: })();

(End of file - total 131 lines)
</content>
